description: Natural Gas InterIntrastate Pipelines US is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This feature layer, utilizing data from the Energy Information Administration, displays the major natural gas transmission pipelines in the United States, including interstate, intrastate, and gathering pipelines. This layer is checked monthly for updates. Coverage: the United States. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Natural Gas. Its keywords are natural gas pipelines. The portal shows 2025-12-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ESRI Custom License (https://content.esri.com/arcgisonline/docs/tou_summary.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
